readings.title: The Usurpation of Appointed Authority
readings.subtitle: Qoraḥ Ensnared by the Adversary's Rebellion
readings.text:
[Numbers 16:1] And Qoraḥ, son of Yitshar, son of Qehath, son of Lĕvi, took both Dathan and Aḇiram the sons of Eliyaḇ, and On, son of Peleth, sons of Re’uḇĕn,
[2] and they rose up before Mosheh with some of the children of Yisra’ĕl, two hundred and fifty leaders of the congregation, called ones of the meeting, men of name.
[3] And they assembled against Mosheh and against Aharon, and said to them, “Enough of you! For all the congregation is set-apart, all of them, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is in their midst. Why then do you lift up yourselves above the assembly of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>?”

readings.title: YeHoVaH Defines His Exclusivity
readings.subtitle: Mosheh Exposes the Grumbling Against the Right Arm
readings.text:
[Numbers 16:4] And when Mosheh heard, he fell on his face,
[5] and spoke to Qoraḥ and all his company, saying, “Tomorrow morning <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall make known <dn>את</dn> who is <dn>His</dn> and <dn>את</dn> who is set-apart, and bring him near to <dn>Him</dn>. And let <dn>Him</dn> bring near to <dn>Him</dn> <dn>את</dn> the one whom <dn>He</dn> chooses.
[6] “Do this: Take fire holders, Qoraḥ and all your company,
[7] and put fire in them and put incense in them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> tomorrow. And it shall be that the one whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> chooses is the set-apart one. Enough of you, sons of Lĕvi!”
[8] And Mosheh said to Qoraḥ, “Hear now, you sons of Lĕvi:
[9] “Is it little to you that the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ĕl has separated <dn>את</dn> you from the congregation of Yisra’ĕl, to bring you near to <dn>Himself</dn>, to perform <dn>את</dn> the service of the Dwelling Place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and to stand before the congregation to serve them,
[10] and that <dn>He</dn> has brought <dn>את</dn> you near to <dn>Himself</dn>, you and <dn>את</dn> all your brothers, the sons of Lĕvi, with you? Yet you seek the priesthood as well?
[11] “Therefore you and all your company are set against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And Aharon, what is he that you grumble against him?”

readings.title: Blindness to the Promised Inheritance
readings.subtitle: Dathan and Aḇiram Reject the Divine Architecture
readings.text:
[Numbers 16:12] And Mosheh sent to call Dathan and Aḇiram the sons of Eliyaḇ, but they said, “We are not coming up!
[13] “Is it little that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you would also seize total rule over us?
[14] “Also, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Would you bore out the eyes of these men? We are not coming up!”
[15] And Mosheh became very displeased, and said to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Do not respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, nor have I done harm to <dn>את</dn> any of them.”

readings.title: The Assembly of the Two Hundred and Fifty
readings.subtitle: The Esteem of YeHoVaH Appears to the Rebels
readings.text:
[Numbers 16:16] Then Mosheh said to Qoraḥ, “Tomorrow, you and all your company shall be there before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you and they and Aharon.
[17] “And take each one his fire holder, and you shall put incense in it. And let each one bring his fire holder before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, two hundred and fifty fire holders, and you and Aharon, each one with his fire holder.”
[18] So each one took his fire holder, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Appointment with Mosheh and Aharon.
[19] And Qoraḥ assembled <dn>את</dn> all the congregation against them at the door of the Tent of Appointment. Then the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> appeared to all the congregation.

readings.title: The Petition to the Elohim of All Flesh
readings.subtitle: Mosheh and Aharon Shield the Congregation
readings.text:
[Numbers 16:20] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, and to Aharon, saying,
[21] <dq>“Separate yourselves from the midst of this congregation, and let <dn>Me</dn> consume them in a moment.”</dq>
[22] But they fell on their faces, and said, “O <dn>Ĕl</dn>, <dn>Elohim</dn> of the spirits of all flesh! When one man sins, are <dn>You</dn> wroth with all the congregation?”
[23] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[24] <dq>“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Move away from around the tents of Qoraḥ, Dathan, and Aḇiram.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Earth Opens Her Mouth
readings.subtitle: Absolute Removal of Systemic Disharmony
readings.text:
[Numbers 16:25] So Mosheh rose up and went to Dathan and Aḇiram, and the elders of Yisra’ĕl followed him.
[26] And he spoke to the congregation, saying, “Please turn away from the tents of these wrong men! Do not touch whatever belongs to them, lest you be consumed in all their sins.”
[27] Then they moved away from around the tents of Qoraḥ, Dathan, and Aḇiram. And Dathan and Aḇiram came out and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
[28] And Mosheh said, “By this you know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has sent me to do <dn>את</dn> all these works, that they are not from my own heart.
[29] “If these die as all men do, or if they are visited as all men are visited, then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has not sent me.
[30] “But if <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> creates what is unheard of, and the earth opens <dn>את</dn> its mouth and swallows <dn>את</dn> them up with <dn>את</dn> all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into She’ol, then you shall know that these men have scorned <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”
[31] And it came to be, as he ended speaking <dn>את</dn> all these words, that the ground under them split apart,
[32] and the earth opened <dn>את</dn> its mouth and swallowed <dn>את</dn> them up, with <dn>את</dn> their households and <dn>את</dn> all the men with Qoraḥ, with <dn>את</dn> all their goods.
[33] So they and all those with them went down alive into She’ol, and the earth closed over them, and they perished from the midst of the assembly.
[34] And all Yisra’ĕl who were round about them fled at their cry, for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
[35] And a fire came out from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and consumed <dn>את</dn> the two hundred and fifty men who were offering incense.

readings.title: The Beaten Bronze Sign
readings.subtitle: A Perpetual Guarantee of the Seed of Aharon
readings.text:
[Numbers 16:36] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[37] <dq>“Say to El‛azar, son of Aharon the priest, to pick up <dn>את</dn> the fire holders out of the blaze, for they are set-apart, and scatter the fire some distance away.</dq>
[38] <dq>“<dn>את</dn> The fire holders of these men who sinned against their own lives, let them be made into beaten plates as a covering for the slaughter-place. Because they brought them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, therefore they are set-apart. And let them become a sign to the children of Yisra’ĕl.”</dq>
[39] And El‛azar the priest took <dn>את</dn> the bronze fire holders, which those who were burned up had brought, and they were beaten out as a covering on the slaughter-place –
[40] a remembrance to the children of Yisra’ĕl that no stranger who is not of the seed of Aharon, should come near to offer incense before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and not be like Qoraḥ and his company – as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had said to him through Mosheh.

readings.title: Standing Between the Living and the Dead
readings.subtitle: Aharon Executes Righteous Covering
readings.text:
[Numbers 16:41] But all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl grumbled against Mosheh and against Aharon on the next day, saying, “You, you have killed <dn>את</dn> the people of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”
[42] And it came to be, when the congregation assembled against Mosheh and against Aharon, that they turned toward the Tent of Appointment. And see, the cloud covered it, and the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> appeared.
[43] And Mosheh and Aharon came before the Tent of Appointment.
[44] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[45] <dq>“Arise from amidst this congregation, and let <dn>Me</dn> consume them in a moment.”</dq> And they fell on their faces.
[46] So Mosheh said to Aharon, “Take <dn>את</dn> the fire holder and put fire in it from the slaughter-place, and lay incense on, and go, hurry to the congregation and make atonement for them, for wrath has gone out from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the plague has begun.”
[47] And Aharon took it as Mosheh commanded, and ran into the midst of the assembly, and saw that the plague had begun among the people. And he laid on the incense and made atonement for the people,
[48] and stood between the dead and the living. And the plague was stopped.
[49] And those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died on account of Qoraḥ.
[50] Then Aharon returned to Mosheh at the door of the Tent of Appointment, for the plague had stopped.

readings.subsection: The Protocol of the Twelve Princes
readings.title: The Rods Placed Before the Witness
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH Moves to Eradicate Grumbling
readings.text:
[Numbers 17:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and take from <dn>את</dn> them a rod from each father’s house, all their leaders according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write <dn>את</dn> each one’s name on his rod,</dq>
[3] <dq>and write <dn>את</dn> Aharon’s name on the rod of Lĕvi, for there is one rod for the head of each father’s house.</dq>
[4] <dq>“You shall then place them in the Tent of Appointment before the Witness, where <dn>I</dn> meet with you.</dq>
[5] <dq>“And it shall be that the rod of the man whom <dn>I</dn> choose buds, and <dn>I</dn> shall rid <dn>Myself</dn> of <dn>את</dn> the grumblings of the children of Yisra’ĕl, which they grumble against you.”</dq>
[6] And Mosheh spoke to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and all their leaders gave him a rod each, for each leader according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. And the rod of Aharon was among their rods.
[7] So Mosheh placed <dn>את</dn> the rods before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in the Tent of the Witness.

readings.title: The Resurrection of the Almond Branch
readings.subtitle: A Living Guarantee Against Future Rebellion
readings.text:
[Numbers 17:8] And it came to be on the next day that Mosheh went into the Tent of the Witness and saw that the rod of Aharon, of the house of Lĕvi, had budded, and brought forth buds, and blossomed and bore ripe almonds.
[9] And Mosheh brought out <dn>את</dn> all the rods from before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to all the children of Yisra’ĕl. And they looked, and each man took his rod.
[10] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Bring <dn>את</dn> Aharon’s rod back before the Witness, to be kept as a sign against the rebels, so that you put an end to their grumblings against <dn>Me</dn>, lest they die.”</dq>
[11] And Mosheh did as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded him, so he did.
[12] And the children of Yisra’ĕl spoke to Mosheh, saying, “See, we shall die, we shall perish, we shall all perish!
[13] “Anyone who comes near the Dwelling Place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> dies. Shall we be consumed – to die?”

readings.title: The Weight of the Set-Apart Service
readings.subtitle: Guarding the Priesthood from the Stranger
readings.text:
[Numbers 18:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Aharon, <dq>“You and your sons and your father’s house with you are to bear <dn>את</dn> the crookedness against the set-apart place, and you and your sons with you are to bear <dn>את</dn> the crookedness against your priesthood.</dq>
[2] <dq>“But bring with <dn>את</dn> you <dn>את</dn> your brothers of the tribe of Lĕvi too, the tribe of your father to join you and serve you while you and your sons are with you before the Tent of the Witness.</dq>
[3] <dq>“And they shall guard your charge, and the duty of all the Tent, but they do not come near the furnishings of the set-apart place and the slaughter-place, lest they die, both they and you.</dq>
[4] <dq>“And they shall be joined with you and guard <dn>את</dn> the duty to the Tent of Appointment, for all the service of the Tent, but a stranger does not come near you.</dq>
[5] <dq>“And you shall guard <dn>את</dn> the duty of the set-apart place and <dn>את</dn> the duty of the slaughter-place, so that there be no more wrath on the children of Yisra’ĕl.</dq>
[6] <dq>“And see, <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> have taken <dn>את</dn> your brothers the Lĕvites from the midst of the children of Yisra’ĕl – a gift to you, given by <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to do <dn>את</dn> the service of the Tent of Appointment.</dq>
[7] <dq>“But you and your sons with you are to guard <dn>את</dn> your priesthood for all matters at the slaughter-place and behind the veil, and you shall serve. <dn>I</dn> have given you <dn>את</dn> the priesthood as a gift for service, but the stranger who comes near is put to death.”</dq>

readings.title: The Covenant of Salt
readings.subtitle: The Most Set-Apart Gifts Appointed to Aharon
readings.text:
[Numbers 18:8] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Aharon, <dq>“And see, <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> have also given you <dn>את</dn> the charge of <dn>My</dn> contributions, all the set-apart gifts of the children of Yisra’ĕl. <dn>I</dn> have given them to you for the anointing, and to your sons, as a law forever.</dq>
[9] <dq>“This is yours of the most set-apart gifts, from the fire: all their offerings, all their grain offerings and all their sin offerings and all their guilt offerings which they render to <dn>Me</dn>, are most set-apart for you and your sons.</dq>
[10] <dq>“Eat it in the most set-apart place – every male eats it. It is set-apart to you.</dq>
[11] <dq>“This also is yours: the contribution of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Yisra’ĕl. <dn>I</dn> have given them to you, and your sons and daughters with you, as a law forever. Everyone who is clean in your house eats it.</dq>
[12] <dq>“All the best of the oil, and all the best of the new wine and the grain – their first-fruits which they give to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – <dn>I</dn> have given them to you.</dq>
[13] <dq>“The first-fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, are yours. Everyone who is clean in your house eats it.</dq>
[14] <dq>“All that is dedicated in Yisra’ĕl is yours.</dq>
[15] <dq>“Everyone opening a womb of all flesh, which they bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, whether man or beast, is yours. But to ransom: you shall ransom <dn>את</dn> the first-born of man, and <dn>את</dn> the first-born of the unclean beast you ransom.</dq>
[16] <dq>“And ransom their ransomed ones when one new moon old, according to your valuation, five sheqels of silver, according to the sheqel of the set-apart place, which is twenty gĕrahs.</dq>
[17] <dq>“But the first-born of a cow, or the first-born of a sheep, or the first-born of a goat you do not ransom, they are set-apart. Sprinkle <dn>את</dn> their blood on the slaughter-place, and burn <dn>את</dn> their fat as an offering made by fire for a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[18] <dq>“And their flesh is yours, as the wave breast and as the right thigh, it is yours.</dq>
[19] <dq>“All the contributions of the set-apart gifts, which the children of Yisra’ĕl present to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have given to you and your sons and daughters with you as a law forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with you and your seed with you.”</dq>

readings.title: YeHoVaH as the Sole Inheritance
readings.subtitle: The Tithe as Reward for Active Service
readings.text:
[Numbers 18:20] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Aharon, <dq>“You are not to have an inheritance in their land, nor have any portion in their midst. <dn>I</dn> am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Yisra’ĕl.</dq>
[21] <dq>“And see, <dn>I</dn> have given the children of Lĕvi all the tithes in Yisra’ĕl as an inheritance in return for the service which they are serving, <dn>את</dn> the service of the Tent of Appointment.</dq>
[22] <dq>“And let the children of Yisra’ĕl no more come near the Tent of Appointment, lest they bear sin and die,</dq>
[23] <dq>because the Lĕvites shall do <dn>את</dn> the service of the Tent of Appointment, so they themselves bear their crookedness. A law forever, throughout your generations: that among the children of Yisra’ĕl they are to have no inheritance,</dq>
[24] <dq>but <dn>את</dn> the tithes of the children of Yisra’ĕl, which they present as a contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have given to the Lĕvites as an inheritance. That is why <dn>I</dn> have said to them, ‘Among the children of Yisra’ĕl they have no inheritance.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Tenth of the Tithe
readings.subtitle: Rendering the Best to the Creator
readings.text:
[Numbers 18:25] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying,
[26] <dq>“Speak to the Lĕvites and say to them, ‘When you take from <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ĕl <dn>את</dn> the tithes which <dn>I</dn> have given you from them as your inheritance, then you shall present a contribution of it to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, a tenth of the tithe.</dq>
[27] <dq>And your contribution shall be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing-floor and as filling from the winepress.</dq>
[28] <dq>Thus you also present a contribution unto <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from all your tithes which you receive from <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ĕl. And you shall give from it <dn>את</dn> the contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to Aharon the priest.</dq>
[29] <dq>From all your gifts you present <dn>את</dn> every contribution due to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, from all the best of them, <dn>את</dn> the set-apart part of them.’</dq>
[30] <dq>“And you shall say to them, ‘When you have presented the best of it, then the rest shall be reckoned to the Lĕvites as the yield of the threshing-floor and as the yield of the winepress.</dq>
[31] <dq>And you shall eat it in any place, you and your households, for it is your reward for your service in the Tent of Appointment,</dq>
[32] <dq>and bear no sin because of it, when you have presented the best of it, and do not profane <dn>את</dn> the set-apart gifts of the children of Yisra’ĕl, lest you die.’ ”</dq>
